original_report: recursive countdown never terminates for negative input.
diagnosis: Recursion needs a base condition covering all nonpositive inputs.
patch_diff:
--- a/target.py
+++ b/target.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def countdown(n):
-    if n == 0:
+    if n <= 0:
         return []
     return [n] + countdown(n - 1)
